where: the lane rule (write only) and scripts/
what: A new script must be Rust (tools/python-allowed.txt takes no new file) and a lane may not run cargo or blaze on the Mac, so a generator of checked-in data cannot be run by the lane that writes it; the data was produced with a Python prototype kept outside the tree.
cost: two implementations of two generators; the Rust ones are unrun
cause: the two rules were written for different cases and meet at data generators
workaround: a prototype, and a how-to row (regenerate-shipped-symbol-lists) saying the Rust generator must be shown to write the same bytes
fix: a lane may run `blaze run -p scripts --bin <name>` for a script that only reads and writes files, or the loop takes a script to run
